power.note: Predeclared 2026-11-03 before any game (Jerry approved after reading the Sparks of Weight-Space Programming paper). Candidate planner_handwritten_leaf = served planner_offer_accept whose build-search leaf is a hand-written evaluation (src/catan_ai/handwritten_leaf.py): every constant written once from game knowledge, none fitted to data; designed against the learned-leaf failure modes (no purchase-deficit terms, cards in hand worth .8 vs 12 per VP, 4:1 trades cost three cards' value, hand over 7 penalized), minus .5 x the strongest opponent's value. Only a 4-game smoke check of speed was run before freezing; constants were not changed after it. Control served planner_offer_accept. Standard screen: observed paired lift >= +.05 on tactical, mixed and self, 128 seeds per table, fresh seeds 2590000/2591000/2592000. A descriptive AUC on the pinned end-of-turn test corpus (runs/value-gate-end-v1/test) is reported separately and is not a gate. A fail parks the arm; no retuning.
